Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna and Terra sat down, and Sol and Gemma were the killers. On day one Luna claimed officer and checked Sol as a killer, while Sol countered with a claim of officer of their own, and the town voted Sol out. Night two the doctor, Terra, blocked a kill, and on day two Luna cleared Haiku while Gemma kept insisting Luna's check settled everything, which drew suspicion. Terra's questions never exposed a role, and the town voted Gemma out to win the game. The mistake was Sol claiming officer after Luna had already named them, and the brilliant move was Terra pressing Gemma without revealing the doctor role.
